[[CD Tenerife|Tenerife]] |} ===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)=== A total of 22 teams will contest the league, including 15 sides from the [[2024–25 Segunda División|2024–25 season]], three relegated from the [[2024–25 La Liga]], and four promoted from the [[2024–25 Primera Federación]]. ;Teams promoted to La Liga On 25 May 2025, [[Levante UD|Levante]] became the first side to mathematically be promoted, assured of a return to the top flight after a three-year absence following a 3–2 victory against [[Burgos CF|Burgos]]. [[Elche CF|Elche]] became the second team to be promoted on the last day after defeating [[Deportivo de La Coruña|Deportivo La Coruña]] 4–0, returning after a two-year absence. The final team promoted was [[Real Oviedo]], who secured their spot via the [[2025 Segunda División play-offs|play-offs]], marking a return to the top flight after a 24-year absence. ;Teams relegated from La Liga The first team to be relegated from La Liga were [[Real Valladolid|Valladolid]], after a 5–1 loss to [[Real Betis]] on 25 April 2025, after only single season stay in the top tier. The second team to be relegated [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]], after a 0–1 loss to [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] on 14 May 2025, after two seasons in the top tier. The third and final team relegated to Segunda was [[CD Leganés|Leganés]], after [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]] managed to survive by beating Valladolid in the last matchday, after just one season in the top tier. ;Teams relegated to Primera Federación The first team to be relegated to the third level was [[FC Cartagena|Cartagena]], after a 2–1 loss to [[UD Almería|Almería]] on 14 April 2025, ending a five-year stay in the second division. The second team to be relegated was [[Racing de Ferrol|Racing Ferrol]], who were relegated on 29 April 2025 after a loss to Almería, ending their two seasons in the second division. The third team to be relegated was [[CD Tenerife|Tenerife]], who were relegated on 10 May 2025, following [[Real Zaragoza]]'s win against Cartagena, ending a 12-year stay in second division. The fourth and final team to be relegated was [[CD Eldense|Eldense]], who were relegated on 25 May 2025, following a 3–3 draw against [[Racing de Santander|Racing Santander]], ending a 2-year stay in the second division. ;Teams promoted from Primera Federación On 11 May 2025, [[AD Ceuta FC|Ceuta]] became the first team to achieve promotion to Segunda División, following a 2–1 win against [[CF Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]], returning for the first time in 57 years, it will also be the first time the city of Ceuta will have a representative in the category in 45 years. The second team to earn promotion was [[Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa|Cultural Leonesa]] following a 1–1 draw against [[FC Andorra|Andorra]] in the last matchday on 24 May 2025, after a 7-year absence. The third team to secure promotion was [[FC Andorra|Andorra]], who returned after a one-season absence on 21 June after beating [[SD Ponferradina|Ponferradina]] 2–1 on aggregate in the first promotion playoff. The fourth and final team was [[Real Sociedad B]], who defeated [[Gimnàstic de Tarragona|Gimnàstic]] 4–3 on aggregate in the second promotion playoff, securing their return to the division after three years.
